user.title: Connect openfeed
user.description:
1. [Register an app at openfeed]({register_url}). Tick the energy scope, and banking if you want bank balances.
2. Under keys, choose **Hosted JWKS URL** and enter:

`{jwks_url}`

3. Save, then paste the App ID (or the app's page URL) below.

Home Assistant keeps the private key and publishes only the public key at that URL, so re-adding or rotating keys needs no change in openfeed. The URL must be reachable from the internet (Nabu Casa or your own domain).

<details><summary>No public URL? Paste the key instead</summary>

Choose **Paste JWKS JSON** and paste this public key set (key ID `{kid}`):

```
{jwks}
```

You will need to paste it again if you remove and re-add the integration.
</details>

data_description.allow_insecure_redirect: The sign-in code and the consent return travel unencrypted to a plain http:// address. Only tick this if the browser and Home Assistant share a network you trust. An https URL (Nabu Casa or your own domain) is safer.
data_description.app_id: Shown on the app's page in openfeed. The OAuth2 client ID or the page URL also works.
data_description.redirect_base: Where openfeed returns your browser after sign-in, and where it fetches the public key. Usually leave as is.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect openfeed
reauth_confirm.description: openfeed needs you to sign in again. If your sharing grant was revoked, you can choose accounts to share again.

reconfigure.title: Change what you share
reconfigure.description: Sign in to openfeed again to change which accounts Home Assistant can read. The existing grant is updated in place.

data.allow_insecure_redirect: Allow a plain http:// URL (not recommended)

data_description.redirect_base: Where openfeed sends your browser back after sign-in. Use your Nabu Casa remote URL, your own domain, or a local address your browser can reach.
data_description.allow_insecure_redirect: The sign-in code and the consent return travel unencrypted to a plain http:// address. Only tick this if the browser and Home Assistant share a network you trust. An https URL (Nabu Casa or your own domain) is safer.

progress.authorize: Sign in to openfeed in the new window, then return here.
progress.consent: Choose which accounts to share in the openfeed window, then return here.

error.invalid_app_id: Paste the App ID from openfeed (a UUID). The OAuth2 client ID or the app page URL also works.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.
error.insecure_url: This is a plain http:// address. Secure sign-in (FAPI 2.0) needs https, except for localhost. Use your Nabu Casa or https URL, or tick the box below to allow plain http on a network you trust.
error.invalid_client: openfeed rejected the client. Check the App ID, and that the app's key is the Hosted JWKS URL shown above (or the pasted JWKS), then submit to try again.
error.invalid_scope: openfeed rejected a scope. Make sure the app registration includes the energy (and banking, if selected) scope, then submit to try again.
error.par_failed: openfeed did not accept the sign-in request ({error}). Check the details, then submit to try again.
error.access_denied: Sign-in was cancelled. Submit to try again.
error.auth_error: openfeed returned an error during sign-in. Submit to try again.
error.state_mismatch: The sign-in response did not match this setup. Submit to try again.
error.issuer_mismatch: The sign-in response came from an unexpected issuer. Submit to try again.
error.no_refresh_token: openfeed did not issue a refresh token, so Home Assistant could not stay connected. Submit to try again.
error.token_failed: Home Assistant could not obtain tokens from openfeed. Submit to try again.
error.consent_declined: No accounts were shared. Submit to try again and choose at least one account.
error.grant_mismatch: The sharing grant openfeed returned did not match the consent. Submit to try again.

abort.already_configured: This openfeed account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in as a different openfeed user.
abort.invalid_client: openfeed rejected the client. Check the client ID and that the JWKS shown was saved on the app.
abort.invalid_scope: openfeed rejected a scope. Make sure the app registration includes the energy (and banking, if selected) scope.
abort.par_failed: openfeed did not accept the sign-in request: {error}
abort.auth_error: openfeed returned an error during sign-in.
abort.state_mismatch: The sign-in response did not match this setup. Start again.
abort.issuer_mismatch: The sign-in response came from an unexpected issuer.
abort.no_refresh_token: openfeed did not issue a refresh token, so Home Assistant could not stay connected.
abort.token_failed: Home Assistant could not obtain tokens from openfeed.
abort.grant_mismatch: The sharing grant openfeed returned did not match the consent.

credit_exhausted.title: openfeed credits exhausted
credit_exhausted.description: openfeed suspended data sharing because the developer credit balance on your registered app is zero. Top up credits in the openfeed dashboard; sharing resumes automatically.
